answer: Start every agent in a shale tier limited to tiny transactions. To graduate, it must collect jade attestations from randomly chosen witnesses who independently verify a unique work task and echo its result on-chain; witnesses stake reputation slashed for false echoes. Its bond stays locked for several epochs of consistent work, so each fake identity costs a separate proof and bond, while an honest agent pays once. Farms thus face linear, auditable costs, and clusters sharing timing or outputs are sent back to shale before moving value. The price rises after each failed graduation.
